ir.name: builder_gap_threshold_pairs_003
ir.intuition: Filter out near-ties by requiring a minimum objective gap, reducing noisy/ambiguous comparisons while keeping clear winner/loser signal; threshold is configurable via extra['gap_threshold'].
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # lower objective is better; only keep pairs with a clear margin to reduce noisy supervision
    gap_threshold = 0.0
    if extra is not None and 'gap_threshold' in extra and extra['gap_threshold'] is not None:
        gap_threshold = extra['gap_threshold']
    gap = objective[:, :, None] - objective[:, None, :]
    # winner i vs loser j when objective[i] < objective[j] - gap_threshold
    mask = gap < (-gap_threshold)
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'gap_threshold_pairs', 'gap_threshold': gap_threshold})
